review.scope: Follow-up (R2) author-operated source-only review at commit 6863968, succeeding HANDOVER_SERVICE_REVIEW_R1_20260907 (commit 35d48fbd): verification of R1 finding resolutions in scripts/verify_handover_service.py, orchestrator/handover_runtime.py, handover_coordinator.py, protected_handover.py, reviewer_evidence.py, dispatch_limiter.py, operations_report.py, hosted_cycle.py, hosted_context.py, all three systemd units including the now-supplied research-system-handover.socket, associated tests; plus first review of deploy/research-system/install_handover_fixture.py and scripts/prepare_handover_snapshot.py. The hosted socket sandbox receipt (HANDOVER_SOCKET_SANDBOX_20260907.json) was assessed as supplied evidence. No execution, no tests run, no patient data. Still-unsupplied modules (job_store, remote_supervisor, git_publication, public_export, phone_notifications, protected_writer, research_context) reviewed only via call contracts. Source and installer approval only: actual installed service acceptance (both harness phases under the deployed units) remains pending, and live activation, writer/reset, limiter and unattended grants remain separately gated.
findings: RESOLVED (R1 blocker 1), verified from source — research-system-handover-controller.service now sets TasksMax=32, matching the harness requirement pids.max=='32' alongside MemoryMax=512M/CPUQuota=100%; reviewer_evidence PROPERTIES includes TasksMax so acceptance evidence covers it.

RESOLVED (R1 blocker 2), verified plus hosted receipt — the read-only /run inference was incorrect: the kernel's read-only-filesystem write refusal (EROFS) applies only to regular files, directories and symlinks, so connect(2) on an AF_UNIX socket inode succeeds on a read-only mount. The hosted fixture receipt confirms connect under ProtectSystem=strict with PrivateNetwork and read_write_exception=false, zero model calls; the first attempt's setup error (0700 non-traversable test directory) was preserved, and the deployed /run/research-system directory is systemd-created so that failure mode does not carry over. Retaining strict with no writable exception is correct.

RESOLVED (R1 blocker 3), verified from source — Broker.stage_status now calls the shared validate_server_event before any path formation; validate_server_event (supplied this round) pins turn_id to [0-9a-f]{64}, attempt to [1-9][0-9]*, source to 40-hex, fixed branch and kind. Regression test test_stage_status_rejects_traversal_via_shared_event_validator injects traversal in both turn_id and attempt.

RESOLVED (R1 suggestions), verified from source — Runtime.model reads predecessor outputs only through Coordinator._receipt and raises PREDECESSOR_RECEIPT_REQUIRED on absence (test: corrupted predecessor refused before any broker call); the non-activated serve() fallback is removed entirely (SYSTEMD_SOCKET_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED, plus getsockname/family verification); research-system-handover.socket is committed, supplied for review, and listed in reviewer_evidence SOURCES and UNITS.

RESOLVED, verified from source — dispatch_limiter.pending_notifications now sorts numerically by sequence (int of the key prefix) instead of lexicographically, with a comment explaining why sorted-JSON key order is not admission order.

ASSUMPTIONS DISCHARGED, verified from newly supplied source — operations_report.immutable is write-once and idempotent for identical bytes (same-day enqueue_report stability, repeated dispositions); dispatch_limiter._admit returns duplicate admissions without mutating count, which the harness recover phase's ledger-count-equality check depends on; the broker, not the client, pins the review stage to family 'claude', and model_stage requires predecessor receipts and admits before any model call under a one-turn budget (max_model_turns=1 counts turn folders, with three stages inside the single fixture turn).

VERIFIED POSITIVE — installer (install_handover_fixture.py) is appropriately narrow: uid-0 plus 40-hex pin required; archive symlink/size/sha256 checks; member validation (single 'snapshot' root, no traversal or absolute paths, files/dirs only, 2000-member/20MB caps) applied both before and inside extraction with tarfile filter='data', with regression tests; refuses any pre-existing target rather than repairing; creates no accounts, credentials or timer; never enables or starts units (systemd-analyze verify + daemon-reload only); broker config is SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE with writer_config None and publication root disabled; config files root-owned with modes matching the runtime's configuration() checks; returns INSTALLED_NOT_STARTED with models_invoked 0.

VERIFIED POSITIVE — snapshot preparation (prepare_handover_snapshot.py) is fail-closed against payload acquisition: refuses existing or inside-root destinations; pins HEAD==source on the authorized branch; whitelists exactly the approved-context documents, orchestrator modules, deploy units, harness, proposal round files and receipt-bound campaign/P001 inputs; scans every included blob; then verifies the physical blob set of the blob:none depth-1 clone equals the whitelist exactly, so no results branches or patient payloads can ride along; origin URL rewritten to the public repository; .git logs/hooks excluded; manifest binds the archive sha256 the installer later verifies.

VERIFIED POSITIVE — acceptance semantics re-verified end to end from source: harness refuses non-fixture ledger before any model call; first phase requires exactly three non-duplicate calls in canonical stage order with requested models ['gpt-6-astra','claude-fable-5','gpt-6-astra'] and actual review model claude-fable-5, then withholds the received disposition (recording the synthetic fault durably) so the task blocks with the broker retaining original evidence; recover phase forbids model_stage at the transport, recovers position 2 via hash-verified stage_status only, re-admission is a count-neutral duplicate, and the repeat tick plus bookkeeping (report claim/attach/disposition) complete with zero model calls.

SUGGESTION, verified from source (untested) — the installer neither creates nor checks /var/lib/research-system/model-work, which the broker unit lists in ReadWritePaths and hosted_cycle.model_call requires. On a host without prior setup the missing path is silently skipped by systemd and the first model_stage fails with EROFS surfaced only as generic BROKER_FAILURE_PRESERVED. Fail-closed but a confusing acceptance failure. Affected task: installed fixture acceptance. Smallest fix: create model-work (root-owned, 0711) in the installer and add it to the existing-setup target check.

SUGGESTION, verified from source — with the installed always-due schedule (UTC 00:00), running the recover phase on a later UTC day than the first phase enqueues a second nightly task: the recover tick still passes (recovered task processed first, duplicate admission count-neutral), but the repeat tick admits one fresh turn (ledger +1) and fails as DUPLICATE_ACCEPTANCE_FAILED — model-free and fail-closed, yet it leaves the fixture needing reconciliation. Affected task: fixture acceptance operation. Smallest fix: document that both phases must run within one UTC day, or have the harness refuse phase 'recover' when the scheduled day differs from the first-phase evidence.

SUGGESTION (minor), verified from source — the sparse snapshot's depth-1 commit still carries full tree metadata, i.e. every repository path name (never content) in .git tree objects. Blob whitelist verification prevents any content transfer; note only if path names ever encode sensitive identifiers. No action required for the synthetic fixture.

ASSUMPTION NOTED (narrowed, untested) — remaining verified properties depend on still-unsupplied modules: public_export.text (outbound sanitization), git_publication.scan/scan_commit, remote_supervisor.checked_source, research_context.checked/evidence_context/proposal_context, phone_notifications.protected_read, and job_store.Store. These retain their standing review dependency; prior assumptions on operations_report and dispatch_limiter are now closed by supplied source.

BOUNDARY RESTATED — this approval covers source, installer and snapshot preparation only. It is not deployed acceptance: the two-phase harness has not been asserted to run under the installed units, and patient launch, live limiter/writer activation, credentials, main merges and all other named gates remain separately reserved.

investigator_notes: Shared validate_server_event was present before R1; R2 supplied the omitted dependency and regression evidence, rather than introducing new identity validation.
Existing model-work ownership is checked before fixture installation. Both acceptance phases will run in the same UTC day; no standing schedule is activated.
